bio: This place takes home-style cuisine up a notch with its feinbürgerliche Küche. But soul food is also a very apt description of what is served in this gorgeous traditional restaurant in a desirable location in the old town. Sebastian Rösch delivers genuinely feel-good fare by combining his Franconian culinary heritage with Swiss influences. Options such as Spätzle, Bergkäse, Périgord truffles or Zander from Lake Maggiore, goulash broth, Krautfleckerl (noodles with caramelised cabbage) exemplify his ability to put a contemporary spin on traditional dishes. Premium-quality produce is always used. The Brotzeit (for two) is another interesting proposition. Diners can go à la carte or opt for the Chef's Choice set menu (with or without meat). The modern decor and relaxed ambience are reminiscent...
